paragraphs.text: Pontotoc Ridge Career and Technology Center students are earning manufacturing credentials featured in a new video from the Smart Automation Certification Alliance, or SACA. The Pontotoc County School District shared the video in a Nov. 3 news announcement.

The alliance’s video description says students are gaining practical experience with electrical systems, programmable logic controllers, pneumatics, hydraulics, welding, hand tools and other technologies used by manufacturers.

SACA describes the certifications as evidence of baseline industry knowledge that students can carry into the workforce. The credentials are intended to help students demonstrate those skills to future employers.
